note: These points are carried over from SafeSteps' existing Embu-area hazard list. They have not been cross-checked against an NTSA, county, or police report, so they are labelled 'Community/local knowledge' rather than 'Official' until verified. Replace 'source' and set verified:true once you've confirmed a point against a named report (NTSA annual report, county traffic office, gazetted blackspot list, etc.) — see the README note at the bottom of this file for how to add real official data.

hotspots.description: Kubu-Kubu Junction — poor visibility, heavy matatu turning traffic.
Embu Market Roundabout — congested; boda bodas weave between vehicles.
Kangaru School Crossing — no zebra crossing; children cross during rush hour.
Embu–Meru Highway Bypass — high-speed through traffic, limited pedestrian paths.
Karurumo Stage — matatu stage spills into the road, blind spots.
Manyatta Market Area — busy foot traffic mixed with boda bodas.

readme: HOW TO ADD REAL OFFICIAL DATA: set 'source' to the exact report name (e.g. 'NTSA Annual Report 2025' or 'Embu County Traffic Dept, June 2026'), set 'verified' to true, and the app will show a shield badge and list it under 'Official Hotspots'. Do not mark a point verified unless you can point to the specific document or office that confirmed it — county road-safety committees and the NTSA county office are the best contacts for gazetted blackspot lists.
